note: rebuild Oct 29: hook re-cut and 75 s cap (IMPROVE 00a, 00c), fresh opus reviewer, fix round 1
reasons: Answers: 1 It teaches you to put three prices on every quote. ServiceTitan's top 10% offered good, better, best on 57% of home jobs, everyone else on 41%. 68% of 1,100+ homeowners get more quotes when a price is higher than expected. It shows how to build Good/Better/Best, then gives the ACCA figures (4+ options 52%, 1 to 3 options 42%) and says and shows the grouping limit ('It can't show 3 beats 1.'). Every number on screen matches the voice, facts.json and all four captions. 2 Glad to put my name on it: nothing broken, cheap or off-brand. 3 Every number is readable as it is said: 57% at 11.0 s (said 11.21), 41% at 14.5 s (14.41), 1,100+ at 19.5 s (20.19), 68% at 22.5 s (22.31), 1,000+ at 49.5 s (49.86), 52% on the reels at 54.5 s (53.98, 5 and 2 already up at 54.0), 42% in the tray at 57.0 s (57.16), 3 3 3 at 64.5 s. No contradictions. 4 It sounds like a person: 150 to 174 wpm, 0 voice flags. 5 qa.json: all 6 checks PASS (74.43 s, -14.2 LUFS, -3.2 dBTP, 0 black, file decodes clean, mp4 sha matches). The 'frozen' check is a doubtful PASS, see item 5. 6 The first 3 s earn the stop: a cover card with '3 prices' and 57% at frame 0, a cut in to the storefront close-up at 0.5 s and back out at 2.0 s, and the tag flips to '$ $$ $$$' by 3.0 s (said 3.04). The send line at 65.0 s and the Good/Better/Best card at 33 to 43 s give a reason to send or save.

Round-1 fixes confirmed: the hook close-up is a storefront exterior (awning, brick, shop window with the tag, teal door with OPEN, sidewalk, sandwich board), with no drawer cabinets. The cover card is gone by 4.0 s. The close plate hangs on the brick, opens at one line and grows a line at a time, with 'a choice.' landing by 71.5 s. The toolbox sliver is gone. 'A HABIT YOU CAN COPY' is gold on a plum bar at row-name size at 16.07 s. At 56.5 s the tray clears its 4+ lines when the crown flips, then shows '1 to 3 options: 42%' over '4+ options: 52%' at 57.5 s. The gold ONE GROUP clamp shows 59.5 to 63.5 s. The slot machine has no still run of 0.7 s or more from 43.5 to 55.1 s. Earlier faults are not back: no 'Not 1', no sticker on 57%, count-ups don't pass through the other group's figure, no silence at -45 dB, and no spark crosses the plate (nothing cream between y 660 and 760 except item 1).

1 polish 65.9 to 72.0 s: a cream glint sweeps 'Send this to whoever' one letter at a time, about 0.45 s every 1.4 s, and covers each letter as it passes. The 70.31 s sheet freezes it on the 's' of 'this', which looks like the old spark fault in a still. In motion it reads as a shine. A thinner diagonal glint, or a lighter gold instead of cream, would keep each letter readable.

2 polish 19.5 to 20.9 s and 11.23 to 12.57 s: near-still runs of 1.37 s (dark houses) and 1.33 s (score table after 57% lands). Against the 'lots of motion' bar, a window flicker or a cursor blink would help.

3 polish 57.0 to 57.5 s: the reels are still spinning when 'Forty-two' is said (57.16 s) and briefly read '4 6 %' before landing 4 2 % at about 57.5 s. The tray shows 42% on time, so it isn't confusing.
4 polish 2.0 to 3.5 s: Snow stands against the hook card's left edge, his hand just short of 'ServiceTitan' on the source line. No text is hidden, but it's tight.

5 polish (doubtful PASS, qa.json 'frozen'): the detail puts the end card at 65.01 s, but the end card starts at about 72.0 s, so the close sat outside that check. My freezedetect over the full file (n 0.001, 0.7 s) finds nothing over 0.9 s in 65 to 72 s, so it passes, but the qa window should be corrected.

6 polish 19.0 to 19.4 s: the homeowner count-up passes '1,085+' and '1,091+' with the plus sign attached before it settles on 1,100+, before 'eleven hundred' is said. Brief, but dropping the '+' until it lands would be cleaner.
